Name: (ATxCP)Oiiai Cat
Author: ZEMRUBY
Description:
[b][color=#ffd966][size=6][center][/center][/size][/color][/b][b][color=#ffd966][size=6][center][/center][/size][/color][/b][left][b][color=#ffd966][size=6]﻿﻿Do you want to raise a meme kitten on your farm?

[/size][/color][/b][size=4][/size][size=4][color=#cccccc]This mod can fulfill your wish. It adds a CP﻿&AT Version. 
[/color]
[/size][/left][size=4][b]In the [color=#ffd966]CP[/color] Additional Content [/b][/size] [size=4][b]version:
[/b]The pet's sound will be changed to "O!",when the Oiiai cat reaches maximum friendship level, it may gift you meme-related items such as [color=#8e7cc3]Prismatic Shards[/color], [color=#8e7cc3]Magic Sugar Ice Pops[/color], [color=#8e7cc3]Ancient[/color] [color=#8e7cc3]Dolls[/color], and even sing the Oiiai song. [/size][size=4]
[/size][size=4][b]The [color=#ffd966]AT[/color] [/b][/size] [size=4][b]version:
[/b]allows you to have a meowing Oiiai kitten.
[/size][size=4]
[/size][b][size=4]How to use:[/size][/b][list]
[*][size=4]Install the latest version of [b]SMAPI[/b] and [b]Content Patcher [/b]and[b] ﻿﻿AlternativeTextures[/b][/size]
[*][size=4]﻿Put the downloaded mod directly into the [b]mods[/b] folder[/size]
[*][size=4]﻿If you are using the [b][color=#f6b26b]AT[/color][/b] mode, you need to purchase [b]shears[/b] from Robin and then use them to change the kitten's texture.  [/size]
[*][size=4]If you are using the [b][color=#f6b26b]CP[/color][/b] Additional Content mode, you need to adopt the kitten from [b]Marnie's shop[/b].[/size]
[*][size=4]Have fun~[/size]
[/list][size=4]
Recommended to pair with [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37571]Pet Interaction Redux[/url] for a more enjoyable gameplay experience.[/size]
[size=4]﻿If I have time, perhaps I will make more meme pet[/size]s
